N4A/N4B: capture calibration and held-out camera data.

owner
Can this unit’s geometry, clocks and noise support VIO?

image/IMU exporter.

calibration storage and overnight access.

warnings/raw preserved and two verified copies.

Stationary noise data needs a separate recorder and booking.
5/15

N4A/N4B: establish a stable baseline and repeat offline replay.
Question How Tools Hardware Done when Time /
owner
Do trusted inputs give repeatable estimator output?
Resume patch-4 build in its isolated copy; rerun EuRoC MH01 on stable power;
validate factory stereo, estimate camera–IMU parameters, replay three takes and
held-out data.
Native ORB, reviewed PNG/CSV-to-ROS 1 Kalibr bag route, Allan analysis and
trajectory evaluation.
Target 8 GB Pi; confirmed x86 ROS 1/Kalibr workstation; immutable D435i takes and
known-data reference.
Build/linkage, transform and time fixtures pass; configuration provenance,
initialization, tracking and reset histories reviewed.
2–4 engineer-days; add 2–5 days if import/tool compatibility fails.
The ROS 1 calibration conversion is a pre-capture dependency, not a tested tool.
6/15

N4C/N5: live output must stay useful under sustained load.
Question How Tools Hardware Done when Time /
owner
Does a current estimate arrive within approved limits?
Hold binary/settings fixed; run three short repeats then a proposed 30-minute load
including map growth, loops and recovery.
Headless ORB; source-age, queue, drop, reset, CPU/RAM, temperature, storage and
power observers.
Final Pi/camera/cooling/data path; textured marked route; operator and reviewer.
No unexplained input loss or growing backlog; repeatable state;
source-age/resource tails meet controller-approved limits.
1–3 engineer-days; book 2–3 h after N4B review.
A fresh heartbeat cannot make an old camera estimate fresh.
7/15

Keep ORB as the default; switch only on matched evidence.
Use native ORB stereo-inertial for advisory localization after trusted-input, calibration and
live/resource gates.
If corrected N4B inputs still fail repeated reviewed criteria, compare OpenVINS on the same
retained data.
If the goal changes to occupancy mapping, test RTAB-Map under measured Pi load before selecting
it.
If validated wheel/body exports already exist, consider that smaller demo as a separate objective.
Existing build/input work makes ORB the lowest-rework route; it is not a Pi performance ranking.
Run one estimator path first; keep the first camera sessions diagnostic.

N7 supported tests: measure power, mounting and fault response.

rated stand/restraint and independent stop.
No unexpected actuation/reset or loop-limit breach; faults withdraw optional input

A stand supports a test; it does not prove free balance.
10/15

N7 motion: deploy advisory localization under supervision.
Question How Tools Hardware Done when Time /
owner
Can the robot repeat a slow trial and handle Pi loss?
Establish controller baseline; tethered balance with zero references; bounded
manual flat-room motion with advisory pose; test loss and reproduce rollback.
Same reviewed stack; operator runbook; checksummed Mac-origin runtime bundle;
Pi and MCU traces.
Approved tether/cleared route, local stop, controller owner, operator/spotter and
repeated slot.
Retained trials meet preapproved limits; Pi/link/tracking loss is handled; another
operator reproduces startup, stop and rollback.
1–4 engineer-days; 2–3 h motion plus a separate repeat/repair slot.
No autonomous navigation, jumping or automatic resume in this release.
